title: The Captain of the Polestar and Other Tales
summary: A collection of five adventure tales by Sir Arthur Conan Doyle. The title story follows a mysterious Arctic voyage aboard the whaler Pole-Star, where a ship’s doctor records his captain's increasingly erratic behavior and supernatural visions amidst treacherous ice fields. Other tales include 'The Great Keinplatz Experiment,' which explores scientific hubris; 'That Little Square Box,' a mystery of sabotage on a transatlantic steamer; 'John Harrington Cowles' Hiatus,' a tale of literary ambition and betrayal; and 'The Parson of Jackman's Gulch,' a Western adventure. The stories blend suspense, scientific curiosity, and the supernatural, showcasing Doyle's early flair for mystery and exploration.
